name: flow-diagram
title: Flow diagram
description: A Sankey-style flow through successive stages. Each block is one value of a stage, each band is the number of records taking that route, and a block takes the colour of the status most of its records have.
needs: Records with `count` (or one each) and one attr per stage naming the block it passes through. The stage attrs are named by the `stages` option; two or more stages.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Each {unitOne} passes through the stages from left to right. The width of a band is the number of {unit} taking that route, so the eye follows the volume and then the exceptions peeling away from it.
text.chartTitle: How {unit} move from stage to stage
text.chartSub: Select a block to follow it.

options.name: stages
options.description: The attr names, in order, that name the block a record passes through at each stage. Two or more.

options.name: selected
options.description: Name of the block to select when the page opens. Empty selects the block with the most broken records.
